$comment: The widget declarations, owned by the platform and served at /assets/schema/widgets.json: source of the new UI's layout editor forms and of the JSON schemas for layout files (dashjoin-newui: yarn schema, scripts/gen-schema.mjs). One entry per widget id; 'newUI': false marks widgets only the classic UI renders. Property schemas reference the shared definitions in '$defs' with {"$ref": "#/$defs/name"} (JSON Schema 2020-12: keys next to $ref, e.g. a description, apply too); the generated schemas carry these $defs plus widget, form and tableSettings. "deprecated": true: still read, replaced; with "deprecationMessage" (VS Code's keyword) the platform's lint ($djLint) and VS Code also report it - e.g. a property no UI reads any more, with what to use instead; "studio": true: an advanced setting edited in Dashjoin Studio - the browser layout editor offers neither. "contentMediaType" says what a string holds (application/jsonata - see $defs expression -, text/markdown, text/html, text/javascript, text/tsx): the layout editor gives it a large editor, a JSONata expression one with a preview of its result.

title.description: Heading shown above the widget; may contain ${...} templates; translated (the classic layout editor stores an empty title as null)

database.description: Database name, e.g. "northwind" (without the dj/ prefix)

query.description: Query ID from the query catalog (config/dj-query-catalog)

displayHint.description: How the value of one key / column is shown

title.description: Label or column header instead of the key

icon.description: Material icon before the label (display widget), e.g. "payments"

format.description: uri, email, date, date-time, time, currency:EUR (currency:EUR:0 without cents), percent, number, number:2

contentMediaType.description: image/...: the value (URL or data URL) is shown as a picture

hidden.description: Not shown at first: a table starts without the column (the column chooser offers it; exclude leaves it out entirely), the display widget leaves the key out

exclude.description: Never shown: a table leaves the column out (the column chooser does not offer it either), the display widget the key; other columns - also ones added to the table later - still show

filter.description: Tables: the filter the column starts with, as typed in the filter row, e.g. Germany, > 100, ~ text (users can change it)

displaySchema.description: How values are shown (the data stays as it is): a JSON Schema whose properties describe the keys / columns; for a list of rows the row is items.properties. Codes by name: options on a key, a literal [{label, value}] list (JSON tab)

arguments.description: JSONata expression computing the query arguments, e.g. {"year": variable.year}

graph.description: The query is a graph query

context.description: JSONata expression; its result is available as `context` in templates and scripts

widget.description: Widget id: a built-in widget, a config/widget layout, or a runtime component

class.description: Tailwind classes on the widget's frame, e.g. "md:col-span-6" (half the 12 column grid from medium screens up; widgets are full width by default) or "hidden md:block"

size.description: Legacy: width in a 12 column grid. The new UI reads it as class "md:col-span-<size>"; prefer class

card.description: Draw the widget on a card (true) or not (false). Default per widget: table, actionTable, edit, create, links, variable, notebook and button with a form have one; config / runtime widgets set it in their record

style.description: Inline CSS for the widget's frame, camelCase - prefer class. Legacy kebab-case keys are converted; legacy dotted keys ("plugins.legend.display") become chartOptions

roles.description: Only shown to users with one of these roles

if.description: JSONata condition; the widget is hidden while it is falsy

cached.description: Reuse the results of this widget's expressions and catalog queries for 5 minutes instead of fetching them every time (like the classic UI: queries and expressions are only cached when set)

fxHide.description: Legacy: hide below this screen width. The new UI reads it as class "hidden md:block" / "hidden sm:block"; prefer class

isDraft.description: Only visible in the classic UI's layout editor

page.description: Layout root: its children on a 12 column grid; "frame" sets toolbar, sidebar, header and titles for this view

frame.description: The app frame around this view (page, tableLayout, instanceLayout, search; in the dj-frame widget: the app's defaults). A widget ID uses that widget for the region, false hides it

toolbar.description: The bar at the top (default dj-toolbar); false hides it

sidebar.description: The navigation on the left (default dj-sidenav); false hides it

header.description: Above the content, e.g. dj-header (breadcrumbs and title); default: none, as in the classic UI

sidebarOpen.description: The sidebar is open when the app starts

title.description: The view's title, a ${...} template (default: page ID, table name, record label or search term)

tabTitle.description: The browser tab's title, a ${...} template, e.g. "${title} · Northwind" (default ${title})

onRender.description: JSONata expression run when the page renders, before its widgets (e.g. set variables, redirect)

container.description: Groups widgets; optionally repeats them per item of an expression

foreach.description: JSONata expression; children are shown once per result item (available as value)

itemsClass.description: Tailwind classes for the list of foreach items (default: a column with gap-4), e.g. "flex-row flex-wrap" for items side by side

layout.description: Legacy: "horizontal" is read as itemsClass "flex-row flex-wrap"; prefer itemsClass

redrawInterval.description: Read the data of the widgets inside again every n seconds (e.g. the progress of a running function); the rest of the page stays as it is

card.description: Legacy: read as a container with "card": true (text becomes the title); prefer "card": true on any widget

text.description: Header of the panel; may contain ${...} templates
Text, optionally with icon and link

baseUrl.description: Prefix for relative links in the markdown, e.g. "/#/page/"

linkIsId.description: Relative links are record IDs: URL-encoded before baseUrl is prepended

script.description: JavaScript run after the HTML is inserted

display.description: Shows the result of an expression (object: key / value list, array: table)
JSONata expression whose result is shown: an object as a key / value list, an array as a table

icons.description: Classic UI: Material icon per key. Still read (translated into schema.properties.<key>.icon); write the icon in the schema instead

schema.description: How the value is shown (the data stays as it is): for an object its keys (title, icon before the key, format, contentMediaType image/..., options - a literal [{label, value}] list shows labels for codes), for a list of rows items.properties

hideTableActions.description: No filter, column chooser and export buttons (actions on selected rows still show)

hideTablePagination.description: All rows on one page, without row count and page buttons

icon.description: Icon button with an optional link

tooltip.description: Text shown when hovering over the icon (also its accessible name)

table.description: Table of query, expression or table rows

expression.description: JSONata expression yielding the rows (an array of objects); instead of database + query or the current table

table.description: Table of the database whose records are shown (paged and sorted by the platform); with database

mode.description: mobile: a list instead of the table; auto: a list on small screens (below sm); desktop (default): the table

columns.description: The columns, in this order (default: all, in the table's order); others are never shown, not even in the column chooser. In the schema, "exclude": true leaves single columns out (others, also new ones, still show), "hidden": true starts the table without one (it can be chosen)

hideColumns.description: Classic: columns not shown; read as "hidden": true on them in the schema

filters.description: Earlier: filters per column; read as "filter" on the columns in the schema

hideTableActions.description: No filter, column chooser and export buttons (actions on selected rows still show)

hideTablePagination.description: All rows on one page, without row count and page buttons

primaryText.description: List mode: the column of an entry's first line (default: the first key column)

secondaryText.description: List mode: the column of the second line (default: the next column)

tertiaryText.description: List mode: the column of the third line (default: the one after)

leftIcon.description: List mode: a column holding an icon name (Material icons), shown left of the entry

actions.description: Actions on the selected rows: button label -> JSONata expression; the rows are `selected`, e.g. {"Run": "selected.$call(ID)"}

schema.description: How values are shown (the data stays as it is): a JSON Schema of a row - properties with format (uri, email, date, date-time, time, currency:EUR, currency:EUR:0 without cents, percent, number:2), contentMediaType image/..., options (codes: a literal [{label, value}] list shows the labels), title. Over the table's / query's metadata

editable.description: Cells are edited in place (arrows / Tab move, Enter or typing edits, Escape cancels), each as its schema says: type, format, options with widget "select" (a literal list to pick from), ref (pick a referenced record), readOnly; key columns (pkpos) stay. A database table saves the changed column; expression and query tables need onchange

onChange.description: Editable tables: runs for every changed cell with updatedRow (the row without its ID), originalRow and id, e.g. $update('northwind', 'PRODUCTS', id, updatedRow); a database table without it updates the column

onCreate.description: Expression tables: a Create button runs this (then the rows are read again)

onDelete.description: Expression tables: rows can be selected and deleted, this runs per row with id (the key column: pkpos in the schema, else ID or the first ..._ID), e.g. $delete('northwind', 'PRODUCTS', id)

deleteConfirmation.description: Confirmation text asked before the selected rows are deleted; may be a translation key

actionTable.description: Classic: shown as a table widget with these properties (actions on the selected rows); use table

expression.description: JSONata expression yielding the rows (an array of objects)

properties.description: Button label -> JSONata expression; selected rows are available as `selected`

hideColumns.description: Classic: columns not shown; read as "hidden": true on them in the schema

hideTableActions.description: No filter, column chooser and export buttons (actions on selected rows still show)

hideTablePagination.description: All rows on one page, without row count and page buttons

chart.description: Chart of query or expression results (label | value, or series | label | value)

expression.description: JSONata expression yielding the rows to chart: label | value, or series | label | value; instead of database + query

chartOptions.description: Chart.js options merged over the defaults, e.g. {"plugins": {"legend": {"display": false}}}

tree.description: Tree: a recursive catalog query (with an argument), a flat one (dj-navigation), a recursive expression (uses node) or a static expression

query.description: Catalog query; with an argument it is recursive: opening a node runs it again with the node's value

arguments.description: The recursive query's arguments for the roots (default: the current record's key)

expression.description: The nodes {text, href, icon, roles, children} or values; an expression using node is called again for each opened node (node = null for the roots)

edit.description: Edit form for the current record

deleteConfirmation.description: Question asked before deleting (default: Delete this record?)

deleteRedirect.description: After deleting: table (default) or a URL

mutationMode.description: Classic UI only (undoable saves); the new UI saves right away

editRedirect.description: After saving: record (default: stay), table, or a URL

schema.description: Hints per field over the table's (title, widget, options, ...; only what differs); "exclude" or "hidden": true leaves a field out; the order is columns

columns.description: The fields shown, in this order (default: all, in the table's order); others are never shown. Hints per field go into schema; "exclude" or "hidden": true there leaves single fields out

create.description: Form to create a record in the current table

schema.description: Hints per field over the table's (title, widget, options, ...; only what differs); "exclude" or "hidden": true leaves a field out; the order is columns

columns.description: The fields shown, in this order (default: all, in the table's order); others are never shown. Hints per field go into schema; "exclude" or "hidden": true there leaves single fields out

links.description: Outgoing and incoming links of the current record

react-component.description: Runtime React widget - only as the layout of a config/widget record; the record's ID becomes the widget id

source.description: TSX source; usually loaded from <ID>.tsx via "source-pointer": "tsx"

button.description: Runs an expression, optionally with a form; an icon without text is an icon button (named by tooltip)

text.description: Label of the button (default "Run"); may contain ${...} templates

tooltip.description: Icon button: its name (tooltip, screen readers)

onClick.description: Runs on click (after the form is checked; its values are form.<field>) and shows the result, if any

navigate.description: Run on click and navigate to the URL it returns

schema.description: Form shown before the expression runs; its values are available as form.<field>

schemaExpression.description: The form's JSON Schema, computed (instead of schema)

deleteConfirmation.description: Question asked before running, e.g. Really delete all orders?

onScan.description: Adds a scan button to the form: the code read by the camera is "scanned"; an object result fills the form

properties.description: Legacy form fields; replaced by schema

variable.description: Form that sets session variables (use them as variable.x)

schema.description: Form fields; each one sets the session variable of the same name (variable.<field>)

properties.description: Legacy form fields; replaced by schema

search.description: Search box: searches everywhere, the results page narrows down to a database / table; with database (and table) it searches only there

table.description: Search only in this table of the database

spacer.description: Pushes the following toolbar items to the right

logo.description: The app's logo (setting logo-url) and / or name (setting logo-text), linking to the home page; without either: Dashjoin

breadcrumbs.description: The view's breadcrumbs (crumbs in the context); used by dj-header

expression.description: Instead of the view's crumbs: [{text, href}]

heading.description: The view's title (title in the context, see frame.title); used by dj-header

text.description: Instead of the view's title: a ${...} template

logout-button.description: Sign out; with text it shows a label

text.description: Label next to the icon (default: the icon only)

dark-mode-switch.description: Light / dark toggle; shown when the app supports dark mode (color-scheme: light dark in assets/theme.css)

locale-switch.description: Language picker (if more than one locale is configured)

activity-status.description: Classic toolbar activity indicator; ignored by the new UI

layout-edit-switch.description: Turns the in-browser layout editor on and off (shown to admins only)

aichat.description: Chat with AI: messages, answers as markdown (streamed with $sse), sources and tools of the answers, file uploads and voice

onChat.description: Called with messages, newMessage, files and query when the user sends; returns the answer's text, a message, the new message list or the AI app's response, e.g. $sse('aia', $append(messages, newMessage)) (streamed) or $call('aia', $append(messages, newMessage)).choices.message.content

placeholder.description: Shown in the empty input before the first question

uploadEnabled.description: Files can be attached (images as they are, other files as their text)

extensions.description: File extensions that can be attached, e.g. ["pdf", "docx"]

voice.description: Speech input, and answers are read out

language.description: Language for speech input / output (default: the UI's)

display.description: Replacements in answers before they are shown: regular expression -> replacement

baseUrl.description: Prefix for relative links in answers

linkIsId.description: Relative links in answers are IDs: URL-encoded

onUpload.deprecationMessage: uploaded files are passed via onChat
onUpload.description: Legacy upload callback; uploaded files are passed to onChat

url.deprecationMessage: only supported by the legacy chat (url), use expression and onChat instead

extraArgs.deprecationMessage: only supported by the legacy chat (url), use expression and onChat instead

knowledge_base.deprecationMessage: only supported by the legacy chat (url), use expression and onChat instead

type.deprecationMessage: only supported by the legacy chat (url), use expression and onChat instead

name.deprecationMessage: only supported by the legacy chat (url), use expression and onChat instead

tagline.deprecationMessage: only supported by the legacy chat (url), use expression and onChat instead

logo.deprecationMessage: only supported by the legacy chat (url), use expression and onChat instead

system_prompt.deprecationMessage: only supported by the legacy chat (url), use expression and onChat instead

onDelete.deprecationMessage: only supported by the legacy chat (onUpload)

toolsSelectable.deprecationMessage: only supported by the legacy chat (onUpload)

analytics.description: Ad hoc query on a table with filter inputs: columns (with aggregation) and filters chosen in the layout, shown as a chart or a table

query.description: Catalog query whose result is analysed instead of the table

onChange.description: Called with the rows whenever they change (e.g. $setVariable for other widgets)

chart.description: How the result is shown (default table); none: only the filters

columns.description: Projected columns with optional aggregation, e.g. {"name": "COUNTRY", "aggregation": "GROUP_BY"}, {"name": "CUSTOMER_ID", "aggregation": "COUNT"}

aggregation.description: Aggregation; GROUP_BY groups by the column, the others aggregate it per group. None: the plain values

operator.description: Comparison with the entered value (default =); BETWEEN takes two values, IN several, IS_NULL a switch

input.description: Input for the value (default text); select / selectmultiple / slider offer the column's values

title.description: Label of the input (default: the column name)

hideTableActions.description: No filter, column chooser and export buttons (actions on selected rows still show)

hideTablePagination.description: All rows on one page, without row count and page buttons

expression.description: Classic UI only: expression whose result is analysed instead of the table

perPage.description: Rows per page of the result table

diagram.description: Nodes and edges on a diagram, edited through expressions (e.g. an org chart where connecting two people sets who reports to whom)

nodes.description: Nodes: {id, database?, table?, position?: {x, y}, data?: {label}}; a node with database and table opens its record on double click. Without positions the diagram is laid out top to bottom

moveNode.description: Runs when a node is dropped (node: {id, database, table, position}); default: saves the record's X / Y columns if its table has them

addNode.description: Shift / Cmd click on the background asks for a name, then runs this (node: {label, position, shiftKey, metaKey}) and shows the node it returns

removeNode.description: Runs for each deleted node (node); without it nodes cannot be deleted

addEdge.description: Runs when two nodes are connected (edge: {source, target, sourceNode, targetNode}); without it nodes cannot be connected

removeEdge.description: Runs for each deleted edge (edge); without it edges cannot be deleted

editRelated.description: The records of another table that point to the record shown (e.g. order lines on an order): a table to select, edit (one row, in a dialog) and delete, and a form that adds one

prop.description: ID of the foreign key column in the other table, e.g. dj/northwind/ORDER_DETAILS/ORDER_ID

columns.description: The columns / fields shown in the table and the forms, in this order (default: all); others are never shown. In schema, "exclude": true leaves single ones out, "hidden": true starts the table without one

schema.description: Hints per column / field over the table's (title, widget, options, ...; only what differs); "exclude": true leaves one out everywhere, "hidden": true starts the table without the column (it can be chosen) and leaves the field out of the forms

graph.description: Records and their relationships as a graph: click a node to add its neighbours, right click to remove it, Ctrl / Cmd click for details and to find how two records are connected

nodes.description: The first records: records ({database, table, pk}), rows with _dj_resource, or graph query paths, e.g. $query('northwind', 'graph-query')

labelFilter.description: Labels containing this text are not shown

relationships.description: Find connection: the relationships preselected (foreign key column IDs like dj/northwind/ORDERS/CUSTOMER_ID, or column names); default: all

maxHops.description: Find connection: the most hops between the two records (default 4)

map.description: Map (OpenStreetMap) of what the expression returns: an address, [lat, lon], a list of addresses, or {center, zoom, fit, points: [{address | location, color, radius, tooltip, popup, href}], lines: [{path, color, weight, ...}], areas: [{path} | {center, radius}], geojson, countries: {ISO: value}, heat: [[lat, lon, weight]], cluster, legend: [{color, text}], scale, locate, tiles}

display.description: The points; a two-letter ISO country code is located from a built-in table, other addresses are looked up with OpenStreetMap's Nominatim

database.description: Instead of display: the database of a catalog query whose rows are the points

query.description: Catalog query: rows with lat / lon or address columns, plus color, radius, tooltip, popup, href

onClick.description: Run on a click with the clicked point / line / area as value (a click on the map: {lat, lon}), e.g. $setVariable('country', value.Country)

mdxeditor.description: WYSIWYG markdown editor with actions in its toolbar (e.g. AI: shorten, make formal, translate)

markdown.description: The text to edit: markdown, may contain ${...} templates

actions.description: Like a table's actions: label -> JSONata expression (a button), or label -> {label: expression} (a menu). The expression sees markdown (the edited text), selection and menuItem and returns {"markdown": ...} (replaces the text) or {"selection": ...} (replaces the selection), e.g. {"Upper case": "{'selection': $uppercase(selection)}"}

expression.description: Classic: computes the menus ({"menu": [{"type": "select", "label", "value", "items": [{"label", "value"}]}]}), "actions" then maps their values to expressions; use actions with labels

notebook.description: JSONata notebook for administrators (quick checks and repairs; only users with the admin role see it)

url.description: Expression yielding the URL of the Excel file

extraArgs.description: Expression yielding the data for the spreadsheet: {"data": ...}

stepper.description: Container that shows its children as the steps of a wizard (a child's title labels its step). The step shown (from 0) is the session variable named by variable; children move it with $setVariable, finished steps can be clicked to go back

variable.description: Session variable holding the step shown (default step), e.g. $setVariable('step', variable.step + 1); leaving the page resets it

tabs.description: Container that shows its children as tabs (a child's title labels its tab, roles / if hide it); the active tab is remembered per page for the session

foreach.description: Expression returning a list: a tab per item, showing the first child with the item as value

upload.description: Imports files (.csv, .xlsx, .json, .sqlite) into a database: the platform detects tables, columns and types, the user checks them and creates new tables or appends to / replaces existing ones

database.description: The database (default: the one whose page this is)

text.description: Label of the button (default: Upload data)

uploadfile.description: Uploads files or a folder into the app's upload folder

allowFolderSelectionRecursive.description: A selected folder: also the files of its subfolders

preserveFolders.description: Keep the selected folder's structure (else all files go to the upload folder itself)

datagrid.description: Classic: shown as an editable table widget (columns gives its columns, idColumn its key; onchange / oncreate / ondelete are onChange / onCreate / onDelete); use table

onchange.description: Runs when a row is changed

ondelete.description: Runs when a row is deleted

oncreate.description: Runs when a row is created

input.description: A form field as a layout widget (classic layout editor)

name.description: Name of the field (the key of its value in the form)

options.description: JSONata expression yielding the options of a select

required.description: The field must be filled in

format.description: Text format, e.g. email or uri

layout-switch.description: Switches the classic UI's layout editor on and off (the new UI: layout-edit-switch)

type.description: JSON type of the form's value: object

required.description: Fields that must be filled in before the form can be submitted

properties.description: The form's fields, keyed by name (the key of the value in the submitted object)

type.description: Type of the value (default string); array and object get list / nested editors

title.description: Label of the field (default: its name); may be a translation key

widget.description: file: the text (JSON parsed); binary file: a data URL; with metadata: {name, lastModified, size, type, value}; voice: dictation; qrcode: camera scan; json: any JSON as text (lists, objects)

accept.description: File widgets: accepted types, e.g. image/* or .csv

capture.description: File widgets: open the camera on phones (user: front, environment: back)

limit.description: File widgets: maximum size per file in MB

language.description: voice: recognition language, e.g. de-DE (default: the user's language)

ref.description: Foreign key: dj/<database>/<table>/<key column>; the field shows the records' labels and offers them while typing (on items for an array of keys)

pattern.description: Regular expression the value must match

errorMessage.description: Message (or translation key) shown instead of the generic one when the value is not valid

options.description: JSONata expression yielding the options [{label, value}] (plain values: label = value) - a literal list, e.g. [{"label": "Active", "value": "A"}], or computed, e.g. $all('config', 'dj-role').ID or $rest('/rest/ai/models').data.name; widget "select" makes it a closed list, otherwise ("auto complete") suggestions. Keys of a table's records: ref

choices.description: Legacy: read as examples (suggestions), or options with widget "select"; prefer options / examples

hidden.description: Not shown (edit, create and editRelated forms: the field keeps its value)

exclude.description: Left out (edit, create and editRelated forms, and editRelated's table; the field keeps its value)

format.description: JSON Schema format, e.g. email, uri, date, date-time; checked and used to pick the input

writeOnly.description: Password field: masked, never shows a stored value

autocomplete.description: Browser autofill hint, e.g. username, current-password, email

autofocus.description: The field has the focus when the form opens (e.g. a login's user name)

class.description: Tailwind classes placing the field in the form's 12 column grid, e.g. col-span-12 (default: half a row)

properties.description: type object: its fields, keyed by name (like the form's properties)

items.description: type array: the field of each item

reorder.description: Classic UI: items of an array can be reordered

required.description: Classic UI: the field must be filled in (the form's required list does this)

createOnly.description: Edit forms: set when the record is created, read-only afterwards

if.description: Shows the field only if this expression is true (form.<field> holds the values)

size.description: Classic UI: width of the field in a 12 column grid

style.description: Classic UI: CSS style of the field

additionalProperties.description: type object: a map (key / value rows) - the schema of its values, e.g. {"type": "string"}; true: any values

database.$comment: config/dj-database records (model/dj-database/<URL-encoded ID>.json) for the VS Code schema: what the form does not have. The fields come from the dj-database columns and types in the app's dj/config.json (tables.dj-database, gen-schema.mjs); table / record layouts live in tables.<TABLE>

tables.description: Per-table settings, keyed by table name

table.$comment: settings of one table inside a database record

instanceLayout.description: Layout of the record pages of this table (/#/<db>/<table>/<id>); root is usually {"widget": "page"}

dj-label.description: Record title template over the record's fields, e.g. "${FIRST_NAME} ${LAST_NAME}"

title.description: Display name of the table (default: its name)

readRoles.description: Roles allowed to read the table (default: the database's readRoles)

writeRoles.description: Roles allowed to create, change and delete records (default: the database's writeRoles)

tenantColumn.description: Row level access: the column holding the tenant; users see only rows whose value matches their tenant

roleMappings.description: Row level access: role -> column value, for rows whose value is ROLE

properties.description: Column metadata, keyed by column name
